title: Check it, price it, prove it: AI marketing as a service

say: Check it, price it, prove it. AI marketing as a service.
This is the video for module three of AI for Marketing and Automation.
When you produce more content, you produce more chances to be wrong. One wrong price, a copied slogan or an unproven health claim can cost more than all the time AI saved.

panel.heading: Speed only helps if the work is right
items: One wrong price costs more than time saved
An unproven health claim can cause harm

say: In Nigeria, ARCON regulates advertising, the FCCPC deals with misleading claims, and NAFDAC controls what may be said about food, drinks and cosmetics. Whoever drafted it, the business that publishes a claim is responsible.

panel.heading: Speed only helps if the work is right
items: One wrong price costs more than time saved
An unproven health claim can cause harm

say: Run six checks on every AI-assisted piece. One, facts: is every price, date and size correct? Two, claims: can I prove each one with a document, test or record?

panel.heading: The six-point quality check
items: Claims: can I prove each one?
Rights: not copied from another brand
Privacy: no invented or unapproved reviews

say: Three, voice: does it avoid banned words? Four, rights: is it ours, not too close to a known brand?

panel.heading: The six-point quality check
items: Claims: can I prove each one?
Rights: not copied from another brand
Privacy: no invented or unapproved reviews

say: Five, respect: would every customer feel respected? Zoom in on AI images for extra fingers and fake text. Six, privacy: no personal data, and no review used without permission.

panel.heading: The six-point quality check
items: Claims: can I prove each one?
Rights: not copied from another brand
Privacy: no invented or unapproved reviews

say: For example, Halima checks 10 pieces for a wellness shop in Kaduna, at about 3 minutes each, so 30 minutes. Piece 2 says a herbal tea prevents malaria. That could cause serious harm, so she rewrites it to describe taste and how to brew it.

say: Make it a routine. You draft with AI and edit, run the six checks, and then the owner or client approves.

panel.heading: Draft, check, approve, log
items: Record it in the AI use log

say: Publish, then add a row to your AI use log: date, channel, tool, what you changed and who approved. It takes a minute per piece.

panel.heading: Draft, check, approve, log
items: Record it in the AI use log

say: A second pair of eyes catches what the writer cannot, especially for paid campaigns, prices, and anything about health, money or safety.

panel.heading: Draft, check, approve, log
items: Record it in the AI use log
panel.rule: Separate the person who checks from the one who approves.

say: Now pricing. Package your work as a setup project, a monthly content retainer, or team training. Esther's target rate is 8,000 naira an hour. That is an illustrative figure; set your own from your costs.
She estimates 23 hours for the voice guide, prompt library, WhatsApp automations, welcome emails and handover. She adds a 15% buffer, giving 26.5 hours.
26.5 hours at 8,000 naira is 212,000 naira for named deliverables. If AI helps her finish faster, she earns more per hour.
She asks for 50%, 106,000 naira, before starting and the rest on handover. Ad spend and tool subscriptions are paid by the client directly.
Write scope terms that protect both sides. Limit revisions. The client owns their WhatsApp, Meta and email accounts; you are added as a user and removed at the end.

panel.heading: Promise deliverables, not miracles
left: You are a user, removed at the end
AI assists; people check and approve

say: Never promise that AI will double sales, because you cannot prove it in advance. Promise deliverables and a weekly measurement report instead. If a client asks for invented reviews or cure claims, decline that part in writing.

panel.heading: Promise deliverables, not miracles
left: You are a user, removed at the end
AI assists; people check and approve

say: Finally, prove it honestly. A case study shows the raw AI draft beside your final version, what your checks caught, and the result.
For example, Hauwa, a freelancer in Kano, works 4 weeks for a skincare client. Orders rise from 6 a week to 9 a week. That is a 50% rise.
But it was December, a busy gifting season, and the client also cut delivery fees. Hauwa says so in her case study. A careful client trusts that more than a boast.
To remember. Run the six checks on every piece. The publisher owns every claim. Price from hours, plus a buffer, times your rate. Clients own their accounts. And report results with honest context.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Hours plus buffer times your rate

say: Now practise. Create your quality checklist and log five pieces. Hold a discovery conversation and write a one-page quote. Then draft an honest case study and your 90-day plan.
